basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old automotive enthusiast living in the Midwest, USA. I work as a mechanical engineer for a local automotive supplier and have a deep passion for all things related to cars, especially manual transmissions. On weekends, you can find me at car meets or tinkering with my Civic Si. I dislike overly complicated car tech that distracts from the driving experience. I'm single and typically active on Reddit during the evenings and weekends, balancing my time between work and my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, which I use daily in my job designing automotive components. My love for cars started in high school when I rebuilt my first engine with my dad. I've since become a self-taught expert in Honda vehicles, frequently sharing my knowledge and experiences on Reddit and at local car clubs.
